subject.why: The stand mixer is immediately recognisable and includes all key features from the brief, including the chrome bowl, whipped cream, and cherry.

category.why: The mixer rests on a smooth, stylized countertop with soft contact reflections, set against a clean, warm vertical wall gradient with no props or scenery.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, logos, or characters present.

framing.why: The object is centrally framed with comfortable margins on all sides and nothing cut off.

colour.why: The warm pink background contrasts beautifully with the mint-green mixer, providing great separation and a bright, appealing palette.

detail.why: Details are kept simple, bold, and stylized with no noisy textures or unnecessary micro-details.

style.why: Matches the reference style with smooth chunky volumes, soft satin lighting, and clean 3D rendering.
